# LIVING MUD — WORLD MEMORY DESIGN (lane `s2-world-memory`)

**Files read (read-only, nothing written):** `watch/inbox/games_polish/p01-shadowbonk.md` (audit voice: cite path:line, axis rows, counts not vibes); `memory/biography/knot_timeline.jsonl` lines 1–50 (the F1 row: minute-floor unix, 6-decimal proxies, 8-float `theme_vector`, sha256 `commit`, `amended` flag); context: `watch/inbox/wave_spec_livingmud_s2.json:7`, `watch/inbox/index_events.jsonl:2192` (engine-owns-truth), `docs/DNA.md` (residual+registry+leaf; "private residual never remote"; "prune theater, never prune residual core").

Doctrine in one line: **three stores** — visitor rows (GC-able content), per-visitor profiles (pseudonymous identity), world chain (append-only, never rewritten). The Primer property is audible recognition of returners; long-term change is only ever a knot on the world's chain, replayed by the engine — never an LLM edit.

---

## 1. What the MUD remembers per visitor

**Identity:** first visit mints `visitor_id = "mv-" + sha256(world_salt ‖ client_nonce)[:12]`, stored in a first-party cookie. No account, no email, no IP ever enters the id. The id is the only join key.

**Raw visit row — F1 canonical string**, one JSONL line per visit, schema deliberately parallel to `memory/biography/knot_timeline.jsonl:1`:

```json
{"store":"mud.visit.v1","visitor_id":"mv-3fa9c201b7e4","visit_id":"mv-3fa9c201b7e4:20260923T0344","start_minute":"2026-09-23T03:44:00Z","end_minute":"2026-09-23T04:12:00Z","start_unix_minute":1790135040,"end_unix_minute":1790135320,"duration_minutes":28.0,"visits_total":3,"rooms_walked":["tavern_front","stacks_midnight","widows_overlook"],"room_dwell_sec":{"tavern_front":310,"stacks_midnight":900,"widows_overlook":470},"choices":["door:rsvp_left","valve:water_open","take:ledger","give:vesper:receipt"],"deaths":0,"puzzles_solved":["rsvp_door"],"theme_vector":[0.0,0.25,0.0,0.5,0.0,0.0,0.25,0.0],"commit":"<sha256>","amended":false}
```

**Canonicalization rules (the F1 contract):**
- Keys sorted; UTF-8; LF-terminated; no trailing whitespace; floats rounded to 6dp (matches `knot_timeline.jsonl:5`, `0.325305`).
- Time floored to the **unix minute** — never store sub-minute timestamps (`start_unix_minute` pattern, `knot_timeline.jsonl:1`).
- `rooms_walked`: stable engine room IDs (`tavern_front`), lowercase snake, deduped, walk order preserved in the array; dwell in a separate sorted map.
- `choices`: `verb:object` canonical tokens from the engine's validated action enum only (`door:rsvp_left`). Parser prose, free text, and LLM output never enter this array — the engine emits the token at the moment it accepts the action (engine-owns-truth, `index_events.jsonl:2192`).
- `theme_vector`: exactly 8 floats summing ≤1 — the 8-slot allocation copied from `knot_timeline.jsonl:1` so world and visitor rows fold through the same tooling.
- `commit` = sha256 over the canonical JSON of the row **minus** `commit` itself; `amended:false` at seal; amendments never rewrite — they append a successor row with `amended:true` (the `knot_timeline.jsonl:1` flag, used the same way).

**Write path:** visit row opens at connect; engine appends tokens as actions validate; heartbeat seals every 15 min and at disconnect (crash-safe, mirrors `duration_minutes` even when `0.0` as in `knot_timeline.jsonl:3`).

**Sealed rows fold nightly into a profile row** (same F1 discipline, `store:"mud.profile.v1"`): `visits_total`, `first_seen_unix_minute`, `last_seen_unix_minute`, `room_hist`, `choice_hist`, `puzzle_hist`, `theme_vector` = L1-normalized aggregate, `commit`, `amended:false`. The profile is what the world greets: on return, engine injects facts into the narrator prompt — `visits=3, last_room=widows_overlook, doors_opened=2` — **never the visitor_id, never row history.** NPC says "third night in the Stacks" because the engine counted, not because the model read a ledger. That is the Primer property: recognition the model cannot hallucinate.

Files read: `watch/inbox/BUILD_ORDER_LIVING_MUD_20260922.md`, `site/build.py`, `watch/onboard/WORK_WITH_ME.md`, `watch/onboard/STORY.md`, `watch/onboard/GAMEBOOK.md`, `watch/inbox/MIMO_FREE_WINDOW_20260922.md`, `watch/inbox/INDEX.json` (line 4249), `watch/inbox/index_events.jsonl` (line 1373), `dashboard/mud_relay.py`, `wave_spec_livingmud_s1.json`.

## 1. Where the Living Mud room sits in the beacon room flow

The beacon walk page (`work.html`) is assembled by `work_page()` (`site/build.py:297–320`) from `WORK_HERO` + raw HTML in `watch/onboard/WORK_WITH_ME.md` + a hardcoded gate section. Room order today (6 rooms):

| # | id | source |
|---|-----|--------|
| 1 | `top` THE BEACON | `build.py:396–419` (WORK_HERO, plate "ROOM 1/6" at `build.py:398`) |
| 2 | `play` PLAY THE PROOF | `WORK_WITH_ME.md:1–14` (arrakis iframe in `.frame-outer`) |
| 3 | `receipts` THE LEDGER | `WORK_WITH_ME.md:16–33` |
| 4 | `fresh` FRESH RECEIPTS | `WORK_WITH_ME.md:35–48` |
| 5 | `craft` THE CRAFT | `WORK_WITH_ME.md:50–59` |
| 6 | `gate` THE GATE | hardcoded in `build.py:303–313`, plate "ROOM 6/6" at `build.py:304` |

**Decision: insert the Living Mud as a dedicated new room `id="mud"` ("THE LIVING MUD") between Room 2 (play) and Room 3 (receipts)** — it becomes ROOM 3/7; receipts→4, fresh→5, craft→6, gate→7. Rationale:

- It is the flagship exhibit (build order `BUILD_ORDER_LIVING_MUD_20260922.md:34–42`), so burying it below the ledger/fresh receipts is wrong; it belongs right after the proof-of-play room.
- It must NOT be crammed into Room 2's iframe: `.frame-outer iframe` carries `aspect-ratio:16/9` (`build.py:109`), tuned for canvas games, hostile to a tall scrolling text pane with a persistent input line.
- The walker (`WALKER_JS`, `build.py:198–233`) queries `.room` elements dynamically (`build.py:199`) and the minimap is generated from `ROOMS` (`build.py:235–239`), so a new `<section class="room" id="mud" data-name="THE LIVING MUD">` inserted in `WORK_WITH_ME.md` between lines 14 and 16 is picked up with zero walker changes.

**Renumbering fallout (all "6" → "7"):**
- `build.py:398` hero plate `ROOM 1/6` → `1/7`
- `build.py:304` gate plate `ROOM 6/6` → `7/6`→`7/7`; `build.py:303` gate section unchanged otherwise
- `build.py:316` HUD bootstrap `ROOM 1/6` → `ROOM 1/7`
- `WORK_WITH_ME.md:13` door "NEXT: ROOM 3 — THE LEDGER" → retarget to the new mud room; new mud section's door → `#receipts`; plates/doors at `WORK_WITH_ME.md:17,32,36,47,51,58` each +1
- `WORK_NAV` (`build.py:196`) anchor list optionally gains `#mud`; no structural requirement (walker ignores nav)

## 2. Two-tier design: :4096 lane detection + curated fallback

Constraints from the build order (`BUILD_ORDER_LIVING_MUD_20260922.md:22–30, 44–50, 81–101`): public tier fully playable JS-on and JS-off (Lessig); local tier never transmits visitor text off-box (Elder); engine owns truth, `:4096` narrates only, never state.

**Lane facts (from `watch/inbox/INDEX.json:4249` / `index_events.jsonl:1373`):** the lane is `opencode serve` on `127.0.0.1:4096`, transport = `POST /session/{id}/message` with `providerID=opencode`, `modelID=mimo-v2.6-flash-free`; HTTP 200 / cost 0; **raw HTTP can return `FreeTierError` (client-locked)**; window ends ~2026-09-28 (`MIMO_FREE_WINDOW_20260922.md:6–8`), so live mode is a bonus never a dependency.

**Tier decision is runtime, never build-time.** `site/build.py` produces one static, curated artifact (`build.py:2–4`); the local tier is the *same bytes* served from the estate with the lane reachable. Never bake `:4096` endpoints into the build.

Detection state machine (pane JS, default state = `curited`, zero network at load):

1. **Gate A — origin allowlist (hard Elder gate):** only attempt the lane when `location.hostname` ∈ {`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, estate LAN host}. On the public deployment (vercel/workers origin) the probe never fires; tier is statically `curated`.
